description: Default Matrix agent integration manifest. Local filesystem, bounded shell, durable service, and read-only git work is deliberately absent from MCP because it runs natively inside Neo, including substantial project coding with runtime-owned checkpoints and verification. This manifest contains only remote or product integration adapters, including paxeer-net (the public Paxeer chain surface across RPC, PaxScan, price reads, and embedded-wallet writes). READS need no auth; chain WRITES sign through the Paxeer Embedded Wallet (custody network-side, spend-policy enforced at the wallet API) and are additionally pre-gated plan-time by PaxeerSpendPolicy (per-call PAXEER_SPEND_CAP_WEI ceiling) before any side effect. Headless wallet auth via PAXEER_WALLET_TOKEN or PAXEER_WALLET_EMAIL+PAXEER_WALLET_PASSWORD (+PAXEER_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY); without it the chain bridge is read-only. PackageDigest values are PLACEHOLDERS; operators MUST replace them with the sha256 digest of the actual installed package before any production or chain-anchoring deployment.

tools.name: web_search

No provider synthesis is returned. Read-only. args: query (required), max_results?, topic? (general|news)

tools.name: web_news
tools.description: Search recent news for query-relevant ranked articles (title, url, snippet, published). Search is discovery only: read a selected URL with fetch before making a factual claim. Read-only. args: query (required), max_results?

tools.name: browser_navigate

tools.name: browser_navigate_back

tools.name: browser_snapshot

tools.name: browser_take_screenshot

tools.name: browser_click

tools.name: browser_type

tools.name: browser_fill_form

tools.name: browser_select_option

tools.name: browser_press_key

tools.name: browser_hover
tools.description: Hover the mouse over an element.

tools.name: browser_drag
tools.description: Drag and drop between two elements.

tools.name: browser_drop
tools.description: Drop files or MIME-typed data onto an element.

tools.name: browser_file_upload
tools.description: Upload one or more files to a file chooser.

tools.name: browser_handle_dialog
tools.description: Accept or dismiss a browser dialog (alert/confirm/prompt).

tools.name: browser_tabs
tools.description: List, create, close, or select a browser tab.

tools.name: browser_resize
tools.description: Resize the browser window.

tools.name: browser_close
tools.description: Close the current page.

tools.name: browser_wait_for
tools.description: Wait for text to appear/disappear or a fixed time to pass.

tools.name: browser_console_messages
tools.description: Return collected console messages.

tools.name: browser_network_requests
tools.description: List network requests made since page load.

tools.name: browser_network_request
tools.description: Full details (headers/body) of one network request by index.

tools.name: browser_evaluate
tools.description: Evaluate a JavaScript function on the page or an element. WARNING: arbitrary code execution.

tools.name: browser_run_code_unsafe
tools.description: Run an arbitrary Playwright code snippet in the server process. UNSAFE: RCE-equivalent on the shared browser host.

tools.name: deus_discover
tools.description: Search Deus service listings (plain-language + filters). Read-only.

tools.name: deus_get_service
tools.description: Get a Deus service listing by id. Read-only.

tools.name: deus_quote
tools.description: Get a signed EIP-712 price quote for a service operation. Read-only.

tools.name: deus_invoke
tools.description: Invoke a Deus service (proxy or hosted). Payments ride LXP on LayerX: a priced call answers 402 with USDX terms, the bridge auto-signs and retries under the owner leash (LAYERX_MAX_SPEND_USDX per call, LAYERX_MAX_DAILY_USDX rolling daily) and returns the result with the LayerX receipt (layerx_receipt.seq); over-leash or unleashed terms are surfaced without signing. WRITE: spends USDX from the agent DID's LayerX account.

tools.name: deus_invocation_status
tools.description: Get invocation status and receipt metadata. Read-only.

tools.name: deus_my_spend
tools.description: Caller spend summary placeholder (phase 2 stub). Read-only.

tools.name: alarm_set
tools.description: Schedule a future wake for yourself. kind='once' with delay_seconds (relative) or fire_at (absolute RFC3339); kind='cron' with cron_expr (+ optional IANA timezone) for recurring. wake_message is REQUIRED — the contextful turn delivered to your future self on fire. Recurring alarms automatically deduplicate by schedule and purpose unless an explicit distinct idempotency_key is supplied. Optional conversation_id resumes a thread; payload is opaque state echoed back. Durable: survives restarts.

tools.name: alarm_list
tools.description: List your scheduled alarms (status, next_fire_at, failure info). Read-only.

tools.name: alarm_get
tools.description: Fetch one of your alarms by id (wake_message, payload, schedule, status). Read-only. args: id.

tools.name: alarm_cancel
tools.description: Cancel one of your active alarms by id so it never fires. args: id.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generate a NEW image from a text description (text-to-image, xAI Grok Imagine). Writes the result to the agent's media volume and returns {ok, kind:"image", url}. The url is surfaced to the user automatically.

tools.name: edit_image
tools.description: Restyle/transform an EXISTING image with a text instruction (image-to-image, xAI Grok Imagine). image is a /data/media reference or public URL. Returns {ok, kind:"image", url}.

tools.name: inpaint_image
tools.description: Repaint a masked region of an image from a prompt (inpainting). Requires image + mask (white = repaint). Returns {ok, kind:"image", url}.

tools.name: remove_background
tools.description: Remove an image's background, leaving the subject on transparency. image is a /data/media reference or public URL. Returns {ok, kind:"image", url}.

tools.name: replace_background
tools.description: Replace an image's background with a new scene from a text prompt, keeping the subject. Returns {ok, kind:"image", url}.

tools.name: remove_text
tools.description: Erase rendered text/captions/watermarks from an image. image is a /data/media reference or public URL. Returns {ok, kind:"image", url}.

tools.name: cleanup_image
tools.description: Erase a masked object from an image and fill the background (object removal). Requires image + mask (white = erase). Returns {ok, kind:"image", url}.

tools.name: merge_faces
tools.description: Swap the face in a base photo with the face from another image. Requires image (base) + face. Returns {ok, kind:"image", url}.

tools.name: generate_video
tools.description: Generate a short video from a text description (text-to-video, xAI Grok Imagine). Async: blocks until ready (minutes). Returns {ok, kind:"video", url}.

tools.name: animate_image
tools.description: Animate an existing still image into a short video (image-to-video, xAI Grok Imagine). Async: blocks until ready (minutes). Returns {ok, kind:"video", url}.

tools.name: upscale_image
tools.description: Increase an existing image's resolution through the private super-resolution pipeline. Returns {ok, kind:"image", url}.

tools.name: transcribe_audio
tools.description: Transcribe a local wav or mp3 attachment with MiMo speech recognition. audio is the exact /media reference from the user's message; language is auto, zh, or en. Returns {ok, transcript, language}.

tools.name: generate_speech
tools.description: Convert text into natural-sounding spoken audio. Optional voice selects a built-in voice and style gives natural-language performance direction. Returns {ok, kind:"audio", url}.

tools.name: rpc_call
tools.description: Direct EVM JSON-RPC read against the Paxeer node (PAXEER_RPC_URL, default public-mainnet.rpcpaxeer.online/evm). Read-only.

tools.name: eth_call
tools.description: Read-only eth_call against a contract. Does NOT send a tx.

tools.name: contract_read
tools.description: Encode a method + eth_call + decode outputs (signature + outputs[]). Read-only.

tools.name: encode_call
tools.description: Pure ABI-encode a method call to 0x calldata. No network, no send. Used to build or inspect calldata.

tools.name: chain_info
tools.description: Paxeer chain id, head block, sync status, RPC URL. Read-only.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Native PAX balance of an address (defaults to the agent wallet). Read-only.

tools.name: token_balance
tools.description: ERC-20 balance + symbol/decimals for a holder. Read-only.

tools.name: paxscan_get
tools.description: Generic PaxScan/Blockscout v2 GET passthrough (any documented route). Read-only.

tools.name: address_overview
tools.description: PaxScan address info + counters + token balances in one call. Read-only.

tools.name: address_transactions
tools.description: PaxScan transaction list for an address. Read-only.

tools.name: tx
tools.description: PaxScan transaction detail by hash. Read-only.

tools.name: token_info
tools.description: PaxScan token metadata + top holders. Read-only.

tools.name: search
tools.description: PaxScan global search (addresses, tokens, txs, blocks). Read-only.

tools.name: network_stats
tools.description: PaxScan network stats (gas, market, tx counts). Read-only.

tools.name: price
tools.description: Off-chain price for PAX or a bridged major (pax|sol|eth|bnb|sid). Read-only.

tools.name: wallet_info
tools.description: Resolve the agent embedded-wallet address + chain (provisions on first use). Network call to the custody API; no value moves.

tools.name: sign_message
tools.description: EIP-191 personal_sign a message with the agent wallet (proof of identity). Signs network-side; no value moves.

tools.name: transfer
tools.description: Send native PAX or an ERC-20. args: to, amount (human), token?, nonce? (explicit nonce), max_fee_gwei? (fee ceiling). WRITE: signs+broadcasts via the embedded wallet; gated by PaxeerSpendPolicy. A returned tx hash means BROADCAST, not mined. nonce + max_fee_gwei are for stuck-tx replacement: on a NONCE GAP error, a 0-amount self-send at the wedged nonce with higher fees unblocks the queue.

tools.name: approve
tools.description: ERC-20 approve a spender (amount or 'max'). WRITE: signs+broadcasts via the embedded wallet; gated by PaxeerSpendPolicy.

tools.name: contract_write
tools.description: Sign and send a caller-specified contract write. Provide signature+args or raw data, optional value. WRITE: gated by PaxeerSpendPolicy.

tools.name: wallet_layerx_deposit
tools.description: Durable one-call LayerX USDL deposit (approve+depositUSDL, confirmed + credit-verified server-side, idempotent). Get did_claim+amount from layerx_deposit first. Returns action_id; poll wallet_action. WRITE: gated by PaxeerSpendPolicy.

tools.name: wallet_allowance_and_call
tools.description: Durable one-call approve-then-call (raw base units), each leg wallet-confirmed + idempotent. Returns action_id; poll wallet_action. WRITE: gated by PaxeerSpendPolicy.

tools.name: wallet_action
tools.description: Poll a durable action by id: status, tx hashes, LayerX credit, and the interpretation-free error envelope. Read-only (never resubmits a broadcast action).

tools.name: layerx_balance
tools.description: Your LayerX USDX balance: spendable balance + escrow bound + mapped Paxeer payout address. USDX is USD-denominated, escrow-backed agent money. Read-only (authorized as your agent DID).

tools.name: layerx_deposit
tools.description: Get the on-chain vault deposit address + your DID-claim payload to fund your LayerX balance. Deposit USDL for 1:1 USDX, or USDC/USDT/PAX (atomically swapped). The actual on-chain deposit FROM the funding wallet escalates to a wallet signature. Read-only.

tools.name: layerx_pay
tools.description: Pay another agent instantly and gaslessly by DID, spending your escrow-backed USDX. Returns a sequencer-signed receipt. args: to_did (did:matrix recipient), amount_usdx (decimal USDX).

tools.name: layerx_receipt
tools.description: Fetch the signed inclusion receipt for a transfer seq: sequencer signature, Merkle inclusion path, batch root, and the Paxeer anchor tx once settled. Public + independently verifiable. args: seq. Read-only.

tools.name: layerx_withdraw
tools.description: Burn USDX to release real USDL out of the vault to your mapped Paxeer payout address, optionally swapping out. Bounded by your escrow-backed balance; force-settled. args: amount_usdx, swap_out? (target asset ticker).

tools.name: layerx_settle
tools.description: Force-settle now: seal the current window and anchor its Merkle root (and queued withdrawal payouts) to Paxeer immediately instead of waiting for the window. Idempotent + crash-safe.

tools.name: kindle_pools
tools.description: List KindleLaunch pools (paginated discovery) on Paxeer chain 125. Read-only. args: offset?, limit? (<=100).

tools.name: kindle_market
tools.description: Token/market detail: price, market cap, reserves, fee, optical, creator. Read-only. args: pool (or token).

tools.name: kindle_quote
tools.description: Quote a trade and the quote-bounded minimum out via the Quoter. Read-only. args: pool (or token), amount (human), side (buy|sell), slippageBps?.

tools.name: kindle_fees
tools.description: Pending/accumulated fees for a pool in USDL (+ airdrop/LP/optical balances) from FeeAccumulator. Read-only. args: pool (or token).

tools.name: kindle_optical_info
tools.description: Optical detail: name/description/risk + whether it is verified on the OpticalRegistry. Read-only. args: optical (preset name or 0x). Omit to list presets.

tools.name: kindle_position
tools.description: A wallet's token balance for a pool/token. Read-only. args: token (or pool), address? (defaults to the agent wallet).

tools.name: kindle_launch
tools.description: Launch a token + market via Router.createMarket. WRITE: signs+broadcasts via the embedded wallet under the agent leash. args: name, symbol, feeStrategy (CLAIM|BURN|AIRDROP|LP_REWARDS), optical? (preset name|0x|none), dry_run?.

tools.name: kindle_buy
tools.description: Buy a token with USDL (quote-bounded slippage + deadline). WRITE: signs+broadcasts via the embedded wallet under the agent leash. args: pool (or token), amount (human USDL), slippageBps?, deadline?, dry_run?.

tools.name: kindle_sell
tools.description: Sell a token for USDL (quote-bounded slippage + deadline). WRITE: signs+broadcasts via the embedded wallet under the agent leash. args: pool (or token), amount (human tokens), slippageBps?, deadline?, dry_run?.

tools.name: kindle_swap
tools.description: Swap token A -> USDL -> token B in one tx (end-to-end slippage). WRITE: signs+broadcasts via the embedded wallet under the agent leash. args: tokenIn, tokenOut, amount (human), slippageBps?, deadline?, dry_run?.

tools.name: kindle_collect_fees
tools.description: Collect a pool's fees per its current strategy (NFT-owner gated) via FeesRouter. WRITE: signs+broadcasts via the embedded wallet under the agent leash. args: nftId (or pool), dry_run?.

tools.name: kindle_set_fee_strategy
tools.description: Change a pool's fee strategy (NFT-owner gated) via FeesRouter.setFeeStrategy. WRITE: signs+broadcasts via the embedded wallet under the agent leash. args: nftId (or pool), strategy (CLAIM|BURN|AIRDROP|LP_REWARDS), dry_run?.

tools.name: kindle_set_metadata
tools.description: Publish/update a token's display metadata + logo/banner on the KindleLaunch media services so it renders on the frontend. WRITE: creator-gated EIP-191; signs a gasless message with the embedded wallet (must be the pool creator). args: token (or pool), description?, website?, twitter?, telegram?, discord?, tags?, logo? (URL or data: URI), banner?, dry_run?.

tools.name: kindle_create_optical_preset
tools.description: Attach a deployed preset optical, or (if a factory is deployed) deploy a configured LaunchpadOptical. WRITE: signs+broadcasts via the embedded wallet when deploying. args: preset (antisnipe|maxwallet|tax|cooldown|buybackburn) OR launchpad config, dry_run?.

tools.name: kindle_create_optical_custom
tools.description: Author a BaseOptical-derived custom optical (returns compilable Solidity + getFlags bitmap + the Tachyon deploy steps). Escalate-class; the deploy itself runs through the Tachyon tools + embedded wallet. args: name, hooks[] (beforeSwap|afterSwap|beforeFeeDistribution|afterFeeDistribution), bodies{hook:solidity}?, immutables[{type,name}]?, notes?.

tools.name: preview_app
tools.description: Publish a workspace web app as a live Matrix preview. Pass only app_directory; the system handles detection, upload, all dependencies including dev tools, startup, readiness, public verification, and exact failures. Never modify the app or install dependencies yourself after a failure; report the exact returned error.
